content: ओष्ठः [उष्यते उष्णाहारेण, उष्-कर्मणि थन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 4.</ls>] A lip (lower or upper); द्वावोष्ठौ छेदयेन्नृपः <ls>Ms. 8. 282</ls>; अधर˚, बिम्ब˚. .{@-ष्ठी@} A creeper bearing a red fruit to which the lip is commonly compared (बिम्बफल; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>तोण्डली</ns>). [In <ab>comp.</ab> the अ or आ of words before ओष्ठ may be optionally dropped, and the <ab>fem.</ab> may end in आ or ई as बिम्बो(म्बौ)ष्ठा -ष्ठी. (<ls>Vārt.</ls> ओत्वोष्ठयोः समासे वा <ls>Sk.</ls> on <ls>P. VI. 1. 94.</ls>)] [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%ostium%}].
